'''Star Tours Flight 320''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at Gate 2M, and its status was on time, with an estimated time of arrival of 1415. It was scheduled to depart again at 1510.
